name: Pullman Phu Quoc Beach Resort
short_description: Pullman's flagship Vietnam resort, on Phu Quoc's southwest coast 10 minutes from the airport, with 331 rooms, suites, cabanas, and a villa, holding a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (2,195 reviews).
ai_summary: Pullman Phu Quoc Beach Resort is described by Accor as Pullman's flagship hotel in Vietnam, a beachfront resort on the island's southwest coast just 10 minutes from the airport. It has 331 rooms, suites, cabanas, and a villa, aimed at business travellers, couples, and families. The resort has one of the largest review volumes among Accor properties on Phu Quoc, with a 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 2,195 reviews. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: Group 6 Ban Quy Hamlet, Duong Bao Area, Phu Quoc Special Zone, An Giang Province, Vietnam
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

research_highlights: 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 2,195 reviews — highest review count of the Phu Quoc Accor set
research_watchouts: The Accor page lists the address under 'An Giang Province', reflecting Vietnam's 2025 provincial restructuring that folded Phu Quoc's former Kien Giang province into An Giang
